comment: P4c per-ledger owner selector. 'ledgers' has one row per ledger path: 'runtime' means the ledger's tasks are clients of its Rust runtime owner (te.exe serve, kept running by launch\runtime\run_runtime_owner.ps1 under the RuntimeOwnerBatch / RuntimeOwnerScan tasks); 'legacy' leaves the task to run as written, with no owner address. 'tasks' maps a scheduled task's name to its ledger (the client seam knows the task name, not the ledger). 'owners' maps a runtime ledger to the endpoint file its owner's launcher publishes and the environment prefix its clients read; the task wrapper (the client repo's launch\tasks\run_logged.ps1) sets that environment, and refuses (exit 1) when the owner is not running: a runtime row never falls back mid-job. A task or ledger with no row uses 'default'. This file is the ONLY switch the rollback touches.
